periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at approximately 45 degrees downward relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a high length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward taper where the patch narrows toward the ventral snout region.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced reddish-brown staining or pigmentation on the ventral fur and inner hind-limbs.
